Players Committee card image of [[Droideka (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Permanent weapon is Twin Blaster Cannons (may target a character or vehicle; draw destiny; add 2 if targeting a vehicle; if total destiny > defense value, target hit and you may activate 1 Force). While with another [Presence] droid at a site, adds one battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/droideka_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 83cacba] (19 February 2021).
